title: JSON nesting bound
property: jsonDepthExceeds(v, max) equals (reference depth of v, computed in full with an explicit stack) > max for random trees and chains up to depth 1,000, and never throws on chains of depth 10^5 and 10^6 (iterative implementation)

slow.basis: max(1000 ms, 100 x median call time of the first 200 cases); not a timing result

callTimeMs.note: time of the call(s) under test, for the slow-input detector only; not a timing result (untimed series, no quiet-machine protocol)
